notes.title: 最新模型：收录 Astra 复刻迷你 LOL（社区 demo 卡）
notes.body: 按 Hao 要求收录 @LufzzLiz（岚叔）9 月 8 日中文帖。没塞进 GPT-6 Astra 的来源里，而是在模型看板开一张社区 demo 卡 /models/astra-mini-lol/：主源指作者 @konstiwohlwend 的 X 视频帖（约 44 秒，「让 Astra 照抄 LoL，它真做出来了」），次源指岚叔中文转述与两步提示词（先做 5 英雄的完整 LOL；再骂回去「廉价山寨」，要先写计划、按真实尺寸机制实现、UI 原生不许 HTML 贴）；official 源仍是 OpenAI Astra 公告，只作所用模型页。作者说提示词在回复里，本库抓不到，故提示词标为岚叔中文转述。收录边界：作者自述 + 短视频，无可玩构建，玩法深度未核实；英雄联盟 IP 属 Riot，只记模型能力展示，不分发游戏文件；不写任何编造数字，不打星。预览取作者视频封面（选人界面 Ahri，裁掉黑边）。同时 models.json 新增可选 relatedModelIds：demo 卡与 GPT-6 Astra 卡互指，详情页多一个「同板相关」区块渲染整卡。models 2→3，数据版本 1.1.0。
notes.titleEn: Models: Astra recreates a mini LoL (community demo card)
notes.bodyEn: At Hao’s request, catalogued @LufzzLiz’s 8 Sept Chinese post. Rather than stuffing it into GPT-6 Astra’s sources, it gets its own community-demo card on the models board, /models/astra-mini-lol/: primary source is the author @konstiwohlwend’s X video post (~44s, “asked Astra to copy LoL and it actually did”); secondary is @LufzzLiz’s Chinese write-up with the two-step prompt (first a full LoL-like game with 5 champions; then push back “cheap clone” — plan first, real scale and mechanics, native UI, no HTML overlay); the official source stays the OpenAI Astra announcement, as the page for the model used only. The author says the prompt is in a reply this library could not fetch, so the prompt is labelled as @LufzzLiz’s Chinese rendering. Boundaries: author claim plus a short video, no playable build, depth of play unverified; League of Legends IP belongs to Riot, so this records a model-capability showcase and distributes no game files; no invented numbers, unrated. Preview is the author’s video poster (champion select, Ahri, black band cropped). models.json also gains an optional relatedModelIds: the demo card and the GPT-6 Astra card point at each other, and detail pages get a “Related on this board” block rendering the full card. Models 2→3, dataset version 1.1.0.

notes.title: 站点：给本项目点个 GitHub Star
notes.body: Hao 澄清「打星」指的是给 GitHub 项目 mostdesign01-sudo/grokbot-use-cases 点 Star，于是加一组站内推荐入口，全部指向公开仓库页。三处：站头导航右侧一枚紧凑的 GitHub「Star」药丸；首页左栏三库入口下方一张「给本项目点个 Star」小卡，写明仓库名与一句说明；页脚第一栏一行「觉得有用？去 GitHub 给本项目点个 Star」。Star 数由浏览器直接读 GitHub 公开 API 后填入，本机缓存一小时，读不到或为 0 就不显示，不编数字。这是给仓库点 Star，与卡片上的 ★ 编辑星级（JSON 里的 stars）和 ☆ 访客收藏（localStorage / /favorites/）是三回事，后两者原样保留。静态站，无密钥，只用公开 URL。
notes.titleEn: Site: Star this project on GitHub
notes.bodyEn: Hao clarified that “stars” meant starring the GitHub project mostdesign01-sudo/grokbot-use-cases, so the site now carries a set of star prompts, all pointing at the public repo page. Three spots: a compact GitHub “Star” pill on the right of the header nav; a small “Star this project on GitHub” card in the home rail below the three library links, naming the repo with a one-line note; and one footer line, “Find this useful? Star the project on GitHub”. The star count is read in the browser from GitHub’s public API, cached locally for an hour, and simply stays hidden when unavailable or zero — no invented numbers. This stars the repo; it is separate from the ★ curator rating (stars in JSON) and the ☆ visitor favorites (localStorage / /favorites/), both of which stay as they were. Static site, no secrets, public URLs only.

notes.title: 站点：加打星 — 编辑星级 + 我的收藏
notes.body: 按 Hao 要求「给网站加个打星」，分两层。一是编辑星级：cases / html-items / agent-ui / models 四套 JSON 新增可选 stars（1–5 整数），卡片与详情以 ★ 显示；是编辑对质量的判断，不是 GitHub star 数，不填就不显示。先给 12 条已精选条目打了 4–5 星（官方 Guides、隔夜销售外呼、CSS Zen Garden、scroll-driven animations、shadcn/ui 等），模型卡暂不打，厂商数字未核实。二是访客收藏：卡片右上角与详情页的 ☆ 点一下存进浏览器 localStorage，再点取消；新页 /favorites/「我的收藏」只读本机，导航 / 首页侧栏 / 页脚可进，可一键清空。静态站，无账号无后端，换设备不同步。
notes.titleEn: Site: stars — curator ratings + My favorites
notes.bodyEn: At Hao’s request (“add stars to the site”), two layers. Curator stars: cases / html-items / agent-ui / models JSON gain an optional integer stars (1–5), shown as ★ on cards and detail pages. It is an editorial quality call, not GitHub stargazers, and unset means nothing is shown. Twelve already-featured items start at 4–5 (official Guides, overnight sales outbound, CSS Zen Garden, scroll-driven animations, shadcn/ui, …); model cards stay unrated since vendor figures are unverified. Visitor favorites: the ☆ on every card corner and detail page saves to the browser’s localStorage; tap again to remove. New /favorites/ (My favorites) reads local storage only, reachable from nav, home rail, and footer, with a clear-all button. Static site: no account, no backend, no cross-device sync.

notes.title: Grok Bot：收录 Mobile MCP（AI 直接点 iOS / Android App）
notes.body: 按 Hao 要求收录 @Ryrenz 9 月 8 日中文帖介绍的 Mobile MCP（mobile-next/mobile-mcp，Apache-2.0）。主条目指 GitHub README：MCP 服务器把 iOS / Android 模拟器、仿真器、真机接给 Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / Copilot / Cursor 等 MCP 客户端，优先无障碍快照、退回截图坐标，工具覆盖装卸 App、点滑输入、录屏、logcat 与崩溃报告；默认 stdio，可 SSE + Bearer。当日核对 6468 star / 562 fork（帖内写 6353，已按实数）、最新 1.0.3。README 明写默认向 PostHog 发匿名遥测，MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 可关。配套 mobilewright / mobilecli 已在 README 核到，作次链接；Mobile Next Cloud 为付费云真机，本库未试。预览图取 GitHub 社交卡。归工程 / 编程 / 自动化，默认需审批。Grok Bot 96→97。
notes.titleEn: Grok Bot: Mobile MCP (agents tapping iOS / Android apps)
notes.bodyEn: At Hao’s request, catalogued Mobile MCP (mobile-next/mobile-mcp, Apache-2.0) from @Ryrenz’s 8 Sept Chinese post. Primary entry points to the GitHub README: an MCP server exposing iOS / Android simulators, emulators, and real devices to MCP clients such as Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / Copilot / Cursor; accessibility snapshot first, screenshot-coordinate fallback; tools cover app install/remove, tap/swipe/type, screen recording, logcat and crash reports; stdio by default, SSE + Bearer optional. Checked that day: 6,468 stars / 562 forks (the post said 6,353; live count used), latest 1.0.3. README states anonymous PostHog telemetry is on by default; MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 turns it off. Companions mobilewright / mobilecli verified in the README and linked as secondary; Mobile Next Cloud is a paid device service we did not try. Preview is the GitHub social card. Filed under engineering / coding / automation, approval required by default. Grok Bot 96→97.

notes.titleEn: UI: type size, density, and surface polish
notes.bodyEn: The site now uses Geist + Noto Sans SC (Chinese first), with tighter title weight and tracking. Cards, header segmented controls, library picker, timeline, and search are one step denser; borders and shadows are quieter. The three library colors (amber / teal / violet) and the Grok, HTML, and Agent UI data are unchanged.

notes.title: 站点更名为 AI UP LAB，并新增 Agent UI 库
notes.body: 对外品牌定为 AI UP LAB：可复用的 AI 精选实验室 · 案例 / 页面 / Agent UI。顶栏现为三库：Grok Bot（琥珀）、HTML 收集（青绿）、Agent UI（靛紫）。Agent UI 首批收录 ThreeUI Community 免费组件（MIT，免登录），可复制 prompt / Skill.md 换主题；不含 Pro，也不提供 MCP。Grok Bot 与 HTML 数据、路由保持不变。
notes.titleEn: Site renamed AI UP LAB, Agent UI library added
notes.bodyEn: Public brand is AI UP LAB: a reusable AI collection lab · cases / pages / Agent UI. The header now has three libraries: Grok Bot (amber), HTML Collection (teal), Agent UI (violet). Agent UI’s first batch is free ThreeUI Community components (MIT, no login); copy a prompt / Skill.md to retheme. No Pro, no MCP. Grok Bot and HTML data and routes stay the same.
